subject: SIG evidence request: tenant sampling & temporary log-access delivery plan
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna.li@bluewave.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueWave Security <security@bluewave.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: tenant event sampling & transient access workflow

Hi Priyom,

As part of our SIG review for procurement, security has asked for concrete evidence about how Redwood exposes and retains tenant event logs. Specifically we need:

- A sanitized sample export (JSONL preferred) for two tenant IDs of our choosing covering Nov 1–7, 2026 (timestamps in UTC).
- A short mapping document that ties event codes to product features/operations (e.g., EVENT_42 -> model invocation, EVENT_77 -> key rotation).
- The documented export/runbook you use for ad-hoc customer requests (how you generate the export, who runs it, audit trail).
- A statement of retention policy (raw event retention vs. aggregated metadata) and an explanation of customer-access options (presigned S3 URL vs API export vs console download).
- Confirmation of how you sanitize PII and tenant identifiers for shared samples.

Preferred delivery: within 10 business days. Secure transfer: we can accept a presigned S3 link to our bucket or SFTP (we can provide host details after NDA). Also please indicate whether checksums (SHA256) will be provided for delivered files.

Attached: our SIG template (filled partially). Let us know if the 10-day window is realistic or if you need more time.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Li
BlueWave Financial — Security
---
Attachment: BW-SIG-template.xlsx (they attached their partially filled SIG template)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@bluewave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: tenant event sampling & transient access workflow

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear request. We're happy to support. Quick clarifying questions so we scope the deliverables correctly:

1) For the sample export, do you require original tenant IDs or will redacted/hashed tenant IDs be acceptable? We typically hash tenant identifiers in shared samples.
2) Do you need raw request/response payloads (redacted) or only high-level event records (timestamp, event_code, actor, resource)?

Proposed owner / plan: Marissa (cc'd) will own the export runbook and produce the sample; Kim will produce the event-code mapping; Neha will coordinate delivery and confirm secure transfer method.

Our preliminary estimate: 7 business days if redaction/hashing is acceptable; 10 business days if you require raw payloads that need manual review. We can provide SHA256 checksums and a time-limited presigned S3 URL (standard 72-hour expiry) for download.

I'll let Marissa follow up with the technical runbook and timeline.

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@bluewave.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: tenant event sampling & transient access workflow

Hi Anna / team — following up with the technical plan and what we can deliver. Summary:

What we'll provide (one-time delivery):
- sample-tenant-audit-logs.jsonl (JSONL, sanitized): contains event records with hashed tenant_id, UTC timestamps, event_code, outcome, meta fields. IP addresses and raw request bodies will be redacted.
- export-playbook.pdf: step-by-step runbook used by our ops to generate exports, including commands, access window, and audit-log entries for the export job.
- event-code-mapping.csv (inline in the sample and in the playbook): maps internal event_code to product operation and brief description.
- evidence-delivery-timeline.xlsx: delivery milestones and owners.
- SHA256 checksums for each file.

Retention snapshot: raw event data retention is 90 days by default in hosted deployments; aggregated metadata (indices, derived metrics) retained for 365 days. If you have a Dedicated or Private deployment, retention policies can differ and will be documented separately.

Temporary access model: we will provide a presigned S3 URL scoped to the single bucket/prefix with a 72-hour expiry. File-level checksums will be provided in a checksums.txt manifest. The export job will be recorded in our internal audit trail and included in the export-playbook as proof.

Prerequisites & constraints:
- We will hash tenant identifiers with salted SHA256; if you require reversible masking, we need an executed DPA amendment (legal request).
- Large payloads (full request bodies) will require additional manual review and may extend delivery by 3–5 business days.

Timeline (start date: today, 11 Nov 2026):
- Day 0–1: confirm tenant IDs and redaction level (BlueWave to confirm two tenant IDs).
- Day 2–4: run export, sanitize, internal review.
- Day 5–7: packaging, checksum, create presigned URL, and delivery.

Attachments we'll include on delivery: sample-tenant-audit-logs.jsonl, export-playbook.pdf, evidence-delivery-timeline.xlsx.

If that works, please confirm the two tenant IDs and whether hashed tenant IDs are acceptable.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Security Operations — Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: export-playbook.pdf (ops runbook stub)

From: Anna Li <anna.li@bluewave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueWave Security <security@bluewave.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: tenant event sampling & transient access workflow

Thanks Marissa — that plan looks good. A few follow-ups:

- We'll accept hashed tenant IDs (please include the hashing algorithm and whether a salt is used).
- Can you confirm whether event records include model identifiers (model_id) and request/response token counts? We need these to confirm vendor isolation and unit-cost accounting.
- Are KV cache hits/evictions represented as events or are they internal-only?

BlueWave prefers the presigned S3 transfer. Please provide checksums at delivery.

We'll confirm the two tenant IDs by EOD today (we'll send tenant identifiers and a signed NDA amendment if needed).

Best,
Anna
---

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@bluewave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: tenant event sampling & transient access workflow

Anna — thanks, confirmed. BlueWave can provide the two tenant IDs on Tuesday. Quick summary of commitments:

- Deliverables: sample-tenant-audit-logs.jsonl (hashed tenant IDs with salted SHA256; algorithm and salt-handling described in playbook), export-playbook.pdf, evidence-delivery-timeline.xlsx, checksums.txt (SHA256).
- Data fields: timestamp (UTC), event_code, outcome, actor, resource, model_id (when applicable), token_counts (when applicable). KV cache events are included as EVENT_CACHE_HIT / EVENT_CACHE_EVICT with mapping in event-code-mapping.csv.
- Transfer: presigned S3 URL, 72-hour expiry; we'll provide SHA256 checksums alongside.
- Delivery ETA: 2026-11-17 (COB PST) — ops will run the export on that day and provide the link.

Marissa will run the export and Kim will validate the event-code mapping and token/model fields before delivery. Neha will coordinate the HubSpot ticket and send the DocuSign amendment if BlueWave requires reversible masking.

Attachments included on delivery: sample-tenant-audit-logs.jsonl, export-playbook.pdf, evidence-delivery-timeline.xlsx.

Thanks,
Priyom
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Hi Priyom / team — thanks for the clear plan and timeline. BlueWave confirms we'll accept hashed tenant IDs and will sign the NDA amendment if needed. We'll look out for the presigned S3 link and checksums on 2026-11-17.

Regards,
